caption: The drawing depicts a brass drawer pull shown from two different angles on a plain beige background. On the left side of the composition, there is a front view of the drawer pull, which consists of a horizontally-aligned, curved handle attached at both ends to two round backplates with concentric circles, all rendered in shades of gold and yellow with subtle shadowing for three-dimensional effect. To the right of the front view, there is a side view of the same handle showing the curve and how it protrudes outward from the surface. At the bottom left corner, a scale in inches is included, indicating the size of the object, and at the bottom right corner, the name "JANET RIZA" is written. The overall arrangement is centered within a rectangular border.
title: Drawer Pull
